topics.title: The Forgotten Man Who Invented the Traffic Light
topics.safe_title: The Forgotten Man Who Invented the Traffic Light
topics.angle: The forgotten people behind inventions we use every day (traffic lights, TV, cameras, fridges) - told as adventure stories with a twist: who really invented it and why the world forgot them. No religion topics. Hook with a concrete vivid question in the first 10 s -> 5-7 beats, each a mini-story with a visual mechanism -> twist -> short recap. Never dry lists.
